h1: Custom Kraft Mints for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom kraft mints in bulk for eco-friendly branding. Free setup and proofs at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Kraft mints offer a natural, unbleached paper tube that stands out from standard foil-wrapped mints. The earthy kraft material signals an eco-conscious brand to customers and employees alike. These custom kraft mints work well for trade shows, office welcome desks, and sustainable product launches. Decorate the tube with your logo using full-color printing or foil stamping for a premium feel without plastic packaging.
heroAltText: Custom kraft mints in bulk with natural paper tubes and logo printing for eco-friendly branding
